subject: Q2 wrap-up: what your aged lead data reveals
previewText: Your first quarter numbers tell a story. Here's how to read them for Q3 success.

featuredArticle.title: A/B Testing Your Aged Lead Operation: Scripts, Cadences & Channels
featuredArticle.spotlight: Most agents guess their way through script changes and cadence adjustments. This post gives you the statistical frameworks to test everything systematically. When you know your baseline contact rates and can measure lift accurately, every change becomes profitable.
